method: Candidates are Strip-corridor resorts that host at least one 2026 Michelin restaurant. Michelin count = restaurants on the same resort/campus per the official Michelin address list. Transit-time analysis uses the RTC Deuce on the Strip (official schedule: operates 24/7, every 10-15 min 7 AM-1 AM, every 20 min 1-7 AM). The 1-hour bus test covers the entire Strip corridor.
transit_note: Las Vegas has no subway. Public transit on the Strip is the RTC Deuce bus (double-decker). Off-Strip Michelin restaurants require different routes or rideshare.
